Theta GmbH’s strategy of filing multiple patents for next-generation wireless communication is a high-stakes move designed to secure a temporary monopoly on specific technologies. This will likely create significant barriers to entry, forcing your business to either navigate complex licensing negotiations, incur higher costs, or pivot to alternative technical solutions that may be less efficient or more time-consuming to develop. The immediate impact will be a slowdown in your R&D timeline and potential constraints on product features, requiring a strategic reassessment of your intellectual property landscape and competitive positioning.

Regarding the priority question: A book is primarily made of paper.
